blocks.text: Thank you for sending the presentation and the investor questions so promptly. Both are helpful, and the questions in particular give us a clear sense of what investors would like explained more fully.

Daniel's summary of your call matches my understanding, and I have nothing to add to it. We will work the questions into the findings memo, which will come to you before any positioning language is drafted for {{fact:f:E-2017-001.client}}.
